description: BLOCKING watcher review of b651ed9 (li-6b6u6m) found two bypasses of NFR §"Local memory guardrails": (1) scripts/check-memory.ts treats ANY substring occurrence of an .ai/*.md path in AGENTS.md as indexing (agentsIndex.includes(path)), so a stray prose mention outside the Agent-facing notes index lets an unindexed note commit; the spec requires every note to be referenced from the AGENTS.md INDEX with its purpose. (2) The ordinary-tool-configuration allowlist admits the whole .idea/ prefix, so JetBrains workspace/local state (e.g. .idea/workspace.xml) commits cleanly even though AGENTS.md documents it as excluded and the NFR only permits narrower ordinary-config exceptions. Fix: require a real index entry with purpose under the Agent-facing notes index section, and narrow the .idea exception to shareable project configuration (modules.xml, vcs.xml, GitLink.xml, misc.xml, encodings.xml, top-level *.iml, inspectionProfiles/, codeStyles/, runConfigurations/, .idea/.gitignore) with default-deny for the rest. Add red tests for both bypasses (tree mode and the installed pre-commit hook), then update the AGENTS.md policy and closure evidence.
title: Local memory guardrail is bypassable: prose-mention indexing and blanket .idea allowlist

description: BLOCKING watcher review of 3a21662 (li-oaxjqm) found two bypasses of NFR §"Result and railway-oriented programming discipline" in scripts/check-result.ts: (1) the ignored-Result check only inspects bare expression statements, so assigning a Result-typed call to a never-read variable (const _ignored = parse(...)) discards the Result undetected — the spec requires no ignored Result/AsyncResult return values; (2) containsThrow recurses into nested function bodies, so a catch block outside approved adapters that declares a nested function containing a throw, then returns err(...), counts as rethrowing even though the caught bug is swallowed. Fix: flag Result-bound variable declarations whose symbol has no other references (skipping exported bindings and shorthand-property usages), unwrap void/paren/await discards, and stop containsThrow at function/class boundaries so only throws on the actual catch path count. Add red coverage for both repros. Ranked a6B so the fix lands before li-2o7eza (GitHub App / 1Password wrapper) and li-m2trzv (coverage/property), per the watcher instruction.
title: Result/ROP gate is bypassable: unused-variable Result discard and nested-function rethrow

reason: Red -> Green complete. Bypass 1 closed: a Result-typed call bound to a variable whose symbol is never referenced again is flagged as an ignored Result (exported bindings and shorthand-property usages excluded), and void/paren/await discards are unwrapped so a void-discarded Result call also fails. Fix: flag Result-bound variable declarations whose symbol has no other references (skipping exported bindings and shorthand-property usages), unwrap void/paren/await discards, and stop containsThrow at function/class boundaries so only throws on the actual catch path count. Add red coverage for both repros. Ranked a6B so the fix lands before li-2o7eza (GitHub App / 1Password wrapper) and li-m2trzv (coverage/property), per the watcher instruction. REOPENED (2026-07-08, watcher follow-up on 72fc1e2): the never-read check counts ANY identifier reference as a read, so a meaningless two-step discard — const result = parse(...); void result; — launders the ignored Result past the gate. Fix: a reference only counts as a read when it is not a pure discard (operand of a void expression, or a bare/paren-wrapped expression statement). Add red coverage for the two-step void discard and the bare-statement read variant.
